question_summary: Elevation for site retaining wall at Pour 3 conflicts between Grading Plan C-201 and Utility Plan C-301; which elevation governs?
proposed_solution: Use the elevation shown on Utility Plan C-301; Grading Plan C-201 to be corrected by addendum and confirm against the corrected survey benchmark.
deadline_text: Please respond at your earliest convenience.
